import json

# Parse the verified cart data
cart_data = json.loads(verify_out.split('\n[stderr]\n', 1)[0].strip().lstrip('bash: sqlite3: command not found\n(.venv) \n'))

cart_result = cart_data["result"]

report_lines = [
    "# Cart & Shipping Summary",
    f"**Customer ID:** {cart_result['customer_id']}",
    f"**Cart ID:** {cart_result['cart_id']}",
    f"**Date:** 2026-06-15",
    "",
    "## Cart Items",
    "",
    "| # | Product | Qty | Unit Price | Line Total |",
    "|---|---------|-----|-----------|------------|",
]

for i, item in enumerate(cart_result["items"], 1):
    report_lines.append(
        f"| {i} | {item['product_name']} | {item['quantity']} | ${item['unit_price']:.2f} | ${item['line_total']:.2f} |"
    )

report_lines.extend([
    "",
    "## Pricing Breakdown",
    "",
    f"| Subtotal | ${cart_result['subtotal']:.2f} |",
    f"|---|---|",
    f"| Discount | -${cart_result['discount_amount']:.2f} |",
    f"| Gift Wrap Fee | ${cart_result['gift_wrap_fee']:.2f} |",
